original_ai_output.title_zh: 乌干达人民国防军在南苏丹进行武器复训
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 乌干达人民国防军驻南苏丹“沉默守护者”行动部队开始为期三周的武器复训课程，旨在提升战备水平与作战效能。乌干达人民国防军表示，此次训练由联合特遣部队指挥官主持开训。该部队自2025年起应南苏丹总统请求部署在南苏丹。南苏丹定于今年12月22日举行大选，联合国和非盟等国际方面警告称选举准备不足。

key_facts.fact: 乌干达人民国防军驻南苏丹部队开始为期三周的武器复训课程
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Uganda People’s Defence Forces (UPDF) troops in South Sudan under Operation Mlinzi wa Kimya (the Silent Guardian) have commenced a three-week refresher arms course aimed at enhancing combat readiness and operational effectiveness.

key_facts.fact: 乌干达人民国防军自2025年起应南苏丹总统请求部署在南苏丹
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The UPDF has been deployed in South Sudan under Operation Mlinzi wa Kimya since 2025, following a request by South Sudanese President Salva Kiir to his Ugandan counterpart, President Yoweri Museveni, for military support to stabilize the country after renewed fighting.

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹定于今年12月22日举行大选
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: South Sudan, which is slated to hold a general election on 22 December this year, is widely considered not ready for the polls due to critical logistical, financial, and security deficits.

key_facts.fact: 联合国和非盟警告南苏丹选举准备不足
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: International envoys, including the UN and the African Union, warn that preparations are inadequate, citing a lack of voter registration, severe funding gaps, and unresolved security reforms required by the 2018 peace agreement.

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
南苏丹选举能否按期举行尚未确认
